description: Vectors of the FOP stress contract (plan §12.2, §13.3 P7). A vector is a ledger in the compact event form of core_vectors.json over this catalogue, the quotes of one batch (bid/ask for a live mid, or mark and level), a discount rate and scenario points. Hand-worked figures are kept under hand* keys; model figures (sigma, option values, changes with open options) come from the independent reference model tests/helpers/cost_basis_fop_stress_model.py, never from production code. economicPnlModelAnchored is the rational ledger model's replay of the ledger plus the scenario settlements at the scenario marks; change is the position-based change against the anchor, and the two agree (conservation).

pointFields.shift: dollars per barrel added to every futures month
pointFields.slope: dollars per barrel per contract month after the reference month

pricers.name: Black-76 put by put-call parity: P = C - exp(-rT)(F - K)
American (CRR 201 steps, futures) is at least the European value
at a zero rate early exercise is worth nothing: CRR is Black-76 up to the tree error
zero volatility: the American value on a future is its intrinsic value
zero volatility: the European value is the discounted intrinsic value
american stops at a future price of 0 (no epsilon)
american stops at a future price of -3 (no epsilon)
black76 stops at a future price of 0 (no epsilon)
black76 stops at a future price of -3 (no epsilon)
american at expiry: P K=65 at F=-3 is intrinsic 68.0 (F <= 0 allowed)
american at expiry: P K=65 at F=0 is intrinsic 65.0 (F <= 0 allowed)
american at expiry: C K=65 at F=-3 is intrinsic 0.0 (F <= 0 allowed)
black76 at expiry: P K=65 at F=-3 is intrinsic 68.0 (F <= 0 allowed)
black76 at expiry: P K=65 at F=0 is intrinsic 65.0 (F <= 0 allowed)
black76 at expiry: C K=65 at F=-3 is intrinsic 0.0 (F <= 0 allowed)
at expiry (tau = 0) the value is intrinsic whatever the sign of F - K

vectors.name: t=0: the anchor is the ledger valuation
requirements: P7 design: t=0 equals the ledger
vectors.note: Ledger at quote mids: Uf=1000*(72-70)=2000, Co=+1500-800=700, Vo=-1000*1.2+1000*0.5=-700, economicPnl=2000. At the anchor point the change is exactly 0: both sides are the same model evaluation.

vectors.name: no options: every futures month moves linearly, negative prices included
requirements: P7 design: futures-only P&L is linear per month
vectors.note: Ledger: Uf = 2*1000*(72-70) - 1*1000*(72.5-71) = 2500. change = 2*1000*d - 1000*(d + s*1) (G7 is one month after the reference month F7). d=-100 puts CLF7 at -28: valid for futures. Time changes nothing without options; 40 days passes CLF7's last trade (2026-12-17) and stops.

vectors.name: expiry inside the horizon: a delivery keeps the economic P&L
vectors.note: Horizon 2026-12-16 15:00Z: both options expired on 2026-12-14 at the scenario price, CLF7 still trades. CLF7 60: the put is exercised (FUT -1 at 65 closes the long: Rf=-5000), the call expires; with Co=700 the P&L is -4300. 65: both expire, Uf=-5000, -4300. 80: both expire, Uf=10000, 10700. 90: the call is assigned (-1 at 80 closes the long: Rf=10000), 10700. -3: the put still delivers at 65, so a negative CLF7 needs no option model: -4300.

vectors.name: an early delivery differs from holding by the option's time value
vectors.note: At CLF7 82, 10 days on, the short C80 is 2 in the money. Assigned at the horizon it delivers FUT -1 at 80, closing the long (Rf=10000). Holding it instead keeps -1000*V. early - hold = n*mult*(intrinsic - V) = -1000*(2 - V): the short gains the time value. At CLF7 60 the long P65 exercised early gives its time value up: 1000*(5 - V) <= 0. At CLF7 72 the C80 is out of the money, so it is not delivered (it stays open, notDelivered says why); 30 days on it has already settled at its expiry; A70 is no option of this ledger.

vectors.name: each option is priced off its own future: a curve slope moves CLG7 alone
vectors.note: CLG7 is not held, but LOG7 C8500 is bound to it, so its quote is an anchor. With slope 2 and no shift CLF7 stays at 72 and CLG7 moves to 74.5; only the option changes.

vectors.name: a one-sided option quote cannot give an implied volatility
an option whose future is not proven cannot be priced
the future an option is bound to needs its own quote
a one-sided future quote cannot anchor an implied volatility
without a discount rate nothing is computed
an option past its expiry that the ledger still holds must be settled first
a futures price at or below zero stops the model while an option is open
vectors.note: CLF7 at 0 or -3 with both options open: the lognormal models do not apply, so the point is unavailable (no epsilon). CLF7 at 1 is still priced.

vectors.name: the other two deliveries: a short put is assigned long, a long call is exercised long
vectors.note: No future is held. Ledger at mids: Co = +800 - 2500 = -1700, Vo = -1000*0.5 + 1000*3.6 = 3100, economicPnl = 1400. CLF7 60 at expiry: the short put is assigned (+1 at 65, Uf = 1000*(60-65) = -5000), the call expires: -6700. CLF7 80: the long call is exercised (+1 at 70, Uf = 10000), the put expires: 8300. CLF7 67.5: both expire: -1700.

vectors.name: a date-only last trade is read on the exchange date
vectors.note: This CLF7 has only its last trade date, 2026-12-17, and the put only its expiry date. asOf is 03:00Z, 21:00 the evening before in Chicago. The put expires at 13:30 Chicago = 19:30Z (CST) and is assigned onto CLF7 at 60: +1 at 65, two contracts averaging 67.5, 2*1000*(60-67.5)+800 = -14200. 31 days on is 2026-12-18 by UTC but 12-17 at the exchange, so CLF7 still trades: 1000*(77-70)+800 = 7800. 32 days on is 12-18 at the exchange: stop.

vectors.name: a date-only expiry is 13:30 Chicago: 18:30Z in October (CDT)
vectors.note: Daylight saving time: the call expired at 18:30Z, before 19:00Z, and was exercised at 72: 1000*(72-70) - 2000 = 0. CLZ6 (date only, 2026-11-19) still trades.

vectors.name: a date-only expiry is 13:30 Chicago: 19:30Z in December (CST)
vectors.note: Standard time: at 19:00Z the call still has 30 minutes to its 19:30Z expiry, so it is valued, not settled.

vectors.name: a European option is exercised only at its expiry
a flat ledger has nothing to move
requirements: P7 design review: no open position
vectors.note: Bought at 70, sold at 72: Rf = 2000 and nothing is open. No quote, rate or axis is needed; every point is the ledger as it is.
